containerOverrides.name: db-init
command: psql -h "orderflow.csstnjabotrz.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com" -U orderflow -d orders -c "SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, l.sku, l.quantity, o.created_at FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, l.line_no LIMIT 50;"
